name: Aura Bangkok Clinic
lede: Aura is opening branches across Bangkok, the provinces and now Suvarnabhumi Airport, with investor-grade governance after the Fullerton investment. A connected layer turns every launch into a repeatable playbook.
why_h2: Growth, new investors and a world first
why_p: A private equity investment, a high-profile sports partnership and a first-of-its-kind airport clinic all arrived in 2026. Each one adds launches, approvals and reporting to coordinate.

signals.title: Airport clinic opens at Suvarnabhumi
signals.body: Aura opened what it describes as the world's first aesthetic clinic inside an international departure hall, at Suvarnabhumi Airport Concourse G. The network now spans 20 branches with more than 100,000 treatment cases.
signals.angle: A repeatable branch-launch checklist across licensing, fit-out, staffing and marketing, tracked in one place.

signals.title: Rajadamnern Muay Thai partnership
signals.body: Aura announced a partnership with Rajadamnern Muay Thai Stadium.
signals.angle: Partnership marketing has assets, approvals and deadlines that are easier to run in a shared workspace than in chat threads.

signals.title: Fullerton invests in Aura Wellness
signals.body: Fullerton Fund Management invested via the Fullerton Thai Private Equity Fund. Aura reported 2025 revenue of THB 1,746 million and net profit of THB 214 million, with SAP HANA, POS and ERP in place and a workforce of more than 1,000.
signals.angle: A connected layer on top of SAP and ERP for investor reporting and cross-team initiatives.
